# eSIM.dog: full product and price catalogue

> Prepaid travel eSIMs with fixed data allowances, daily high-speed allowances, configurable unlimited plans and regional coverage.

Price snapshot: 2026-11-09. Currency: USD. Each price is for the complete stated package or billing period. Tax may be added at checkout as shown on the product page.

## Products and help
- Country plans: fixed data, or a selectable number of days for unlimited plans. https://esim.dog/
- Regional plans: packages covering several countries. Coverage is listed with each group below. https://esim.dog/regions
- WorldPass: global data subscription. https://esim.dog/worldpass

## Reading the catalogue

For every recommended plan, include its purchase link using the Buy template for that exact variant. If several variants tie, keep each variant and its own purchase link. Cite this full catalogue for price and condition evidence; the short index only provides navigation.
Fixed packages are grouped by destination, total data allowance and duration. Each row lists every available option for that exact data allowance and duration, sorted by total USD price. Equal prices remain separate options. A Days range such as 1-3 gives the same listed options and full-package prices for each of 1, 2 and 3 days. Blue1, Black1 and similar labels refer to the variant conditions and purchase-link templates in the same destination. Use data= from the data-allowance heading for {data_parameter} and the chosen duration for {days}; an option-specific data= value overrides the heading. Regional fixed headings name the exact region, data allowance and duration. The following options are sorted by full package price; plan= supplies {selection}. Preserve all other purchase-link parameters. Networks, coverage, speed and hotspot conditions belong to each exact variant, not to its neighbours.
Unlimited tables use duration rows and a separate column for each plan. Purple fully unlimited plans have no daily quota. Other columns give daily high-speed data and the speed after it is used. A dash means the exact duration is unavailable. Each amount buys the whole stated number of days. A daily high-speed allowance resets each day;it is not a single allowance shared across the trip. Price rows for every supported integer duration are included.
Blue, Black, Green, Yellow and Pink identify the options displayed on eSIM.dog. Amber Essential fixed plans have a 1 Mbps speed cap and do not include hotspot. Purple fully unlimited plans use the speed stated for that group.
The fixed-plan links select the eSIM without a VPN add-on.
